audience: IT providers that back up client servers and workstations with Axcient x360Recover

useCases.title: Find devices with failed backups
useCases.text: List the protected devices with their health status. Then read the run history of a job to see which runs failed and the error message of each.

useCases.title: Check the latest restore point of a server
useCases.text: Find the client and its device, then list the restore points grouped by cloud vault to check the latest recovery point.

useCases.title: Compare storage use across clients
useCases.text: List the clients, then read the local, vault and cloud storage usage of each one.

useCases.title: Review vaults and appliances
useCases.text: List the vaults with their health, storage use and replicated devices. List the x360Recover appliances and read one of them by id.
